text: {"lessons":["Selling winners repeatedly gave me satisfaction, but a gain by itself is no reason to sell; I should consider each holding’s prospects and its role in the portfolio.","My purchase price is not a sound reason to keep a losing position or sell a winning one. I should assess the whole portfolio rather than treating each stock as a separate account.","Prices moved both down and up while I held without trading, and those past moves do not predict what comes next. I should make deliberate decisions based on risk and diversification, not the urge to lock in gains or avoid admitting a loss."]}
